_comment: Real venue check of course_prior.venue_map.json (organizers' COURSE_MAP) from the two hand-carried skybeta-05 loops 20261108-010430_manual / 010807_manual (node half320 stereo depth + VIO; start frame = start mark + start heading). Positions are the official map's: only the barrier could be measured against it (f -0.46 / -0.48 vs -0.457 -> no change) and the start alignment is consistent with it. The maze walls W1-W3 were NOT standing during the recording (the carried path crossed their map positions at f 0.5-0.8, 1.2 m high) and the map's tunnel footprint was walked through at 1 m height: the venue was being set up. Measurements and status of every item: _survey_2026_11_08 (mission-REPORT.md section 33). Re-survey once the course is built.
_comment_source: From the organizers' top-view course map (COURSE_MAP.md), transcribed at +-0.1 m; start frame f=north, l=west, origin=launch. Corridor = first corridor + serpentine maze + Gate A + approach to the tunnel north face. 'chicane'/'gate_b' are extra keys for mission-core (tunnel exit -> around C1 -> Gate B or window -> landing). Refine on site.

gate_b._comment: Gate B = open gap x 10.5 ft, y 8.1-11.5 (C2 north end - barrier). exit_m 0.45: W4 stands 1.13 m beyond the gate centre. 'after' = landing route around W4's SOUTH end (>= 0.6 m from it), then the landing observe-pose search takes over.

_comment_checkpoint4: checkpoint4: 'gate_b' (default when gate_b is given: open gap, no detector) or 'window'.
_comment_walls: walls: board lines from COURSE_MAP.md (replica/layout.py v4 MAZE_WALLS), optional. A stereo cluster on / near one (radius + 0.35 m + walls_tol_m) is never discounted as a net phantom (round B: thin board ends).

_survey_2026_11_08.method: occgrid.py on per-frame pseudo-scans (band 0.30-1.50 m above the floor) + stereo point density; first 10 m of travel per flight (VIO drift <= ~0.3 m; loops close 0.66 / 0.81 m off); weighted line fits, both flights

barrier.status: matches (seen east part only; continues to the east net, map end l -4.103)

west_net.status: consistent (start image: net ~0.5 m to the left); not fitted

north_net.status: UNRESOLVED: an E-W line at f 1.42-1.47 in the north-east is either the net (0.7 m short of the map: corridor points beyond f ~1.05 would be inside the net margin) or a board. Tape-measure before flying past f 1.0

east_net.status: not resolved (two lines, neither straight with the map net; the second is 8-10 m into the loop)

W1_W2_W3.status: absent during the recording (walked through at 1.2 m height)

tunnel.status: not at its map footprint during the recording (walked through at 1 m height); seen in images only

not_in_map.name: board_or_table_start_lane
not_in_map.note: a table 1.1 m ahead of the start in the first image; likely setup clutter
